units.source_text: 一回到寺庙，我便急匆匆地跑到金阁前，这是不足为奇的。

en.t: As soon as I returned to the temple, I hurried straight to the front of the Golden Pavilion, which was hardly surprising.

units.source_text: 观光路上的碎石被仲夏的阳光晒得热腾腾的，我那双质量低劣的运动鞋的胶底却粘了一粒粒小石子。

en.t: The gravel on the sightseeing path had been baked hot by the midsummer sun, and tiny stones stuck one by one to the rubber soles of my cheap sneakers.
